task.title: Filter corpus samples by rejection rationale presence
task.objective: Select records by exact optional rejection-rationale presence without normalizing or inferring rationale content
acceptance_criteria: True matches a non-null rejection rationale, including an empty string
False matches null or an omitted optional field
Rationale text and example type do not alter presence semantics
Filtering preserves deterministic validation and post-filter limits

attempts.summary: Added integration tests for present, null, omitted, empty-string, composition, and failure boundaries
attempts.diagnostic: The CLI rejected the unknown has-rejection-rationale option

attempts.summary: Added strict boolean parsing and direct Option presence matching

outcome.summary: Corpus samples support structural rejection-rationale selection with exact null and omission semantics

lessons: Schema defaults make omitted optional fields equivalent to explicit null
Empty authored text is still structurally present and should not be normalized away
